decision: analysis_only; do not patch V614 based on incomplete human / physical testing

ordinary.scope: core hit pipeline with QA HP, NOT an entire player's sword and gun feel

midboss.scope: native skill setup and ranks, not full human-style fights

titan.scope: native spawn/phase; close/far human combat and other five planned TITAN unverified

triage.issue: Actual 3/5 in-game minute lag on the user's Galaxy S23+ remains unverified; 180s wallclock test advances only 100.7 game seconds.
triage.cause_assessment: Many unattended upgrade overlays paused the engine (15 scripted picks at 10s polling). Do NOT call this a game bug.
triage.action: Improve QA level-up handling to sub-second polling; measure actual >180s in-game clock; ask for on-device FPS/heat/overlay observations when available.

triage.issue: Headless Chrome p95 rAF interval ~33.3ms in 60s and 180s samples vs 16.7ms median.
triage.cause_assessment: Can indicate intermittent half-refresh frames in the emulated browser; desktop runner and Chrome SwiftShader/GPU context prevent phone extrapolation.
triage.action: Compare fixed visual density, avoid new particles, test Galaxy S23+ real frame pacing; optimize only if reproduced.

triage.issue: No full near/far player-aimed TITAN trials; current QA verifies native BIO/VENOM spawns and warning fields.
triage.cause_assessment: Functional QA is not equivalent to playing manually. Other planned TITAN presence not confirmed.
triage.action: Provide short human-play scenarios and capture readings/phase warnings; do not invent missing Titan content.

triage.issue: Crowds of 180/250 living monsters not exercised; terminal enemy counts only 32/58.
triage.cause_assessment: Prior 250 synthetic hit events tested only effect cap.
triage.action: Controlled actual 50/180/250 living-enemy render test with both Canvas/GPU; avoid interpreting synthetic events as FPS.

triage.issue: No verified player ratings for hit punch, death clarity, visual readability, rhythm or eye fatigue.
triage.action: Keep scores null; collect real feedback or wait for user playtest rather than assign artificial 1-5 ratings.

triage.issue: No evidence that new art or additional effects are needed at this stage.
triage.cause_assessment: V614 original artwork and reactions passed functional regression.
triage.action: Do not render new images; re-evaluate only if real user reports a specific visual weakness.
